news.title: Ishaan Infrastructures and Shelters Limited Appoints Ms. Savitri Kumari as Company Secretary and Compliance Officer, Effective March 7, 2026
news.body: Ishaan Infrastructures and Shelters Limited announced that the Board of Directors in its meeting held on March 7, 2026, approved and took note of the appointment of Ms. Savitri Kumari (Mem. No. A79169) as Company Secretary and Compliance Officer designated as Key Managerial Personnel of the Company with effect from March 7, 2026. Ms. Savitri Kumari is a Company Secretary and a member of the Institute of Company Secretaries of India, with experience in ROC/MCA related compliances, statutory filings, drafting of notices, agendas, minutes and resolutions, and maintaining secretarial records while assisting in compliance under the Companies Act and other applicable regulations.

news.title: New major risk - Share price stability
news.body: The company's share price has been highly volatile over the past 3 months. It is more volatile than 90% of Indian stocks, typically moving 9.0% a week. This is considered a major risk. Share price volatility increases the risk of potential losses in the short-term as the stock tends to have larger drops in price more frequently than other stocks. It may also indicate the stock is highly sensitive to market conditions or economic conditions rather than being sensitive to its own business performance, which may also be inconsistent. Currently, the following risks have been identified for the company: Major Risks Share price has been highly volatile over the past 3 months (9.0% average weekly change). Revenue is less than US$1m. Market cap is less than US$10m (₹65.9m market cap, or US$724.7k)

news.title: Ishaan Infrastructures and Shelters Limited Announces Resignation of Ketan Shantilal Sadhu as Chief Financial Officer, Effective January 8, 2026
news.body: Ishaan Infrastructures and Shelters Limited announced that Mr. Ketan Shantilal Sadhu has tendered his resignation from the position of Chief Financial Officer (Key Managerial Personnel) of the Company vide his letter dated January 8, 2026. He has decided to pursue opportunities outside the organization. He will be relieved from the services of the Company with effect from closing hours of January 8, 2026.
